title: 移动边缘计算中基于LLM辅助合同网协商的多智能体调度
summary: 本文提出MAS-DecStream，扩展经典合同网协议为LLM-MR-CNP，支持语义CFP、多轮提案修订和协商记忆。实验表明可降低延迟违规至3%，消除资源过度承诺，冲突解决率达0.91，效用提升22%。
summary_en: This paper proposes MAS-DecStream, extending the Contract Net Protocol with LLM-MR-CNP for semantic CFP, multi-round proposal revision, and negotiation memory. Experiments show reduced latency violations to 3%, eliminated resource overcommitment, 0.91 conflict resolution rate, and up to 22% utility improvement.
